map.能量消耗便携计算是做什么的？: What does Activity Calorie Expenditure Calculator (MET) do?
map.如何使用能量消耗便携计算？: How do I use Activity Calorie Expenditure Calculator (MET)?
map.能量消耗便携计算适合哪些场景？: What scenarios is Activity Calorie Expenditure Calculator (MET) best for?
map.基于 MET 代谢当量数据库，根据活动类型、体重与时长计算消耗热量: Based on a MET (metabolic equivalent) activity database, pick an activity and enter body weight and duration to compute calories burned for fitness tracking, fat-loss planning and energy-balance checks.
map.能量消耗 = MET × 体重 × 时间: Energy expenditure = MET × body weight × time
map.💡 公式：消耗(kcal) = MET × 体重(kg) × 时长(h)。1 k: 💡 Formula: calories (kcal) = MET × body weight (kg) × duration (h). 1 kcal ≈ 4.184 kJ, 1 kcal ≈ 4184 joules.
map.⚠️ MET 为人群平均值，实际消耗受年龄、性别、体脂率、运动效率影响，结果仅供: ⚠️ MET values are population averages; actual expenditure depends on age, sex, body-fat percentage and movement efficiency, so results are for reference only.
map.强度档会调整 MET 值：休闲 ×0.9、适中 ×1.0、剧烈 ×1.2: The intensity setting scales the MET value: leisure ×0.9, moderate ×1.0, vigorous ×1.2
map.常见消耗参考：跑步 30 分钟约 300–400 kcal，骑行 60 分钟约: Common reference values: about 300-400 kcal for 30 minutes of running and about 400-600 kcal for 60 minutes of cycling
map.减脂按运动 MET 值估能耗，比较不同活动单位时间消耗选高效方案。: For fat loss, estimate energy expenditure from each activity's MET value and compare the per-hour cost of different activities to pick an efficient option.
map.约 1 kcal/kg/km；70 kg 跑 5 km ≈350 kcal（匀速: About 1 kcal/kg/km; a 70 kg runner covering 5 km ≈ 350 kcal (steady pace, flat ground approximation).
map.越快单位时间耗能高，但单位距离近似恒定。: The faster you go the more energy per unit time, but the energy per unit distance is roughly constant.
map.为群体均值，个体体重与强度浮动大，结果作估算而非精确值，不宜拿来精确控热量。: They are population averages; individual weight and intensity vary widely, so treat the result as an estimate rather than a precise value and do not use it for exact calorie control.
